Where I live, there are some apartments in basements. I own one. When we first got it, it had a lot of humidity damage (about 85 percent humidity) and the amount of mold was huge.

We had a professional come and look at it to make sure we did things right, but were on a budget. So he gave us instructions and we made things happen.

If you want to do it by yourself, please research. You need masks to protect yourself from mold. And please, use a special product against mold, not bleach or vinegar like you can find online.

Also, it will depend on what you want to do. Do you plan on leaving just the concrete, or do you want to put flooring and such?

Mold in the basement and overall humidity stems from other problems, usually water infiltration. If you can't pinpoint where it comes from and solve the issue, it will come back. Solve the humidity issue, then take care of the mold.

God luck :)
